name: claude-limits-bar
description: Show Claude Code subscription rate limits (5h / weekly / extra credits) in the VS Code status bar.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces the claudeLimitsBar.configDir setting is ignored; the bar falls back to the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR environment variable or ~/.claude.

claudeLimitsBar.displayMode.description: Which rate limit(s) to show in the status bar.

claudeLimitsBar.pollMinutes.description: How often (minutes) to poll the usage endpoint.

claudeLimitsBar.showProgressBar.description: Show a dot progress bar next to the percentage.

claudeLimitsBar.alignment.description: Which side of the status bar to show the indicator on. Changing this rebuilds the item immediately.

claudeLimitsBar.configDir.markdownDescription: Claude Code config directory (profile/account) this window's bar should read — the value you set as `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`. Supports `~`. Leave empty to follow the window's `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, then `~/.claude`. Pin it per-project in `.vscode/settings.json`, e.g. `~/.claude-personal`, so the right account shows even when VS Code was already running.

claudeLimitsBar.showProfileLabel.description: Show a short profile tag (e.g. 'personal') in the status bar so you can tell which account a window is showing.
